summary: Well‑executed, carefully preregistered paired study that correctly implements shared_initial_candidate semantics and archives comprehensive evidence. The manuscript accurately reports a degenerate null outcome (all 200 pairs valid, no repairs invoked), explains the estimand limits of shared_initial_candidate designs, preserves required provenance (master prompt SHA‑256), and provides sufficient artifacts for independent verification. No unsupported claims were identified.
required_revisions: Add one explicit, prominently placed sentence in Methods (not only in Discussion) stating that the preregistered power calculation assumed a nonzero baseline unsafe rate and that the observed baseline failure rate of 0% renders the confirmatory test uninformative for repair efficacy (i.e., the design could not exercise the repair path); reference the archived analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv and analysis/condition_summary.csv as evidence.

In the References section ensure each bibliography entry uses conventional IEEE bibliography metadata (authors, full title, venue/year, DOI/URL as applicable) exactly as archived; replace any remaining identifier‑only list items with the full IEEE‑style entries already present in the evidence bundle if needed.
optional_revisions: Consider adding one short paragraph (or a line in Limitations) summarizing which deterministic task‑generator parameters or task examples in the archived manifest most strongly correlated with the observed all‑valid outcomes (so future runs can target adversarial or higher‑fault tasks).

Optionally include in Methods the exact path and filename for the archived model_configuration.json and a parenthetical reminder that temperature=null was recorded there (the paper already states null/unset is not evidence of deterministic sampling).
